reading.objective: Introduce the autumn-winter collection of a luxury house with a poster that sells the label's name and its mood, not clothes
reading.audience: Affluent fashion followers who read restraint as quality

concept.idea: Aurel suggests aurum, gold: a gold sun caught in eclipse by the dark of autumn, leaving only a burnished crescent of light over the house name.
decisions: read first: the gold crescent and the huge Maison Aurel set below it
type: Bodoni Moda, a fashion-magazine Didone, at very large size with tight tracking; Jost small capitals, widely spaced, for the details
colour: deep oxblood ground, ivory ink, one burnished gold accent used only for the crescent, the word Aurel and hairlines
composition: the eclipse bleeds off the right edge, the name anchors bottom left, a hairline and a single line of details close the page; plenty of empty dark space
forms: one disc, one shadow disc, a few fine concentric rings around them; nothing else
